methodology.cold_restore: fresh process; local store files fadvise(DONTNEED) before open; includes open, protocol verification, every tensor read and SHA-256 check
methodology.default_note: every `configurations.<row>.reproduction` records `shipped_default`, `requires_flag` and `reproduces_with`. Only `A` (the backend's own path) and `C` (the unmodified planned checkpoint write) are shipped defaults; `B`, `D`, `E` and `N` require explicit flags or harness composition, and any key carrying a `-suffix` is an ablation.
methodology.logical_bytes: exact source tensor payload bytes in the subset
methodology.physical_bytes_written: backend counters for WeftFS (probe, LOCK, FORMAT, superblock, commits, manifests, chunks/frames, index segments) or harness PUT/file counters for A/N
methodology.physical_footprint: recursive file walk for local, object listing for S3
methodology.representative_rep: `configurations.X.write`/`.restore`/`.summary` are the median-wall repetition; `summary_least_contended` and `deltas_vs_A_least_contended` use the minimum-wall repetition
methodology.reps: every arm runs once per repetition and the arms are interleaved with a one-position rotation; the receipt publishes every repetition's raw phase JSON and the min/p50/p95/max of every mandatory metric
methodology.warm_restore: second pass in the same process; OS/backend cache warm; no store cache is enabled
methodology.write_wall: source read + store init + encode + index build + every commit + protocol + final durability barrier
